description: Pairwise duplicate detection over tickets from one software project tracker: judge whether completing one ticket makes the other unnecessary, and classify the relationship between them.

legend.auc: area under the ROC curve of P(redundant) against the pair label
legend.board-duplicates.redundant: P(completing one ticket makes the other unnecessary)
legend.board-duplicates.relation: relationship between the two tickets' work
legend.brier: mean squared error of P(redundant) against the pair label
legend.ece: expected calibration error of P(redundant) in ten equal-width bins
legend.precision: precision of P(redundant) at a 0.5 threshold
legend.recall: recall of P(redundant) at a 0.5 threshold

provenance.detail: questions() lines 128-143; report() AUC/Brier/ECE/precision/recall lines 174-189; view() state lines 122-125
